hero.title: Design beyond the brief.
hero.statement: MDORRA is a design studio for architecture and interiors. We take the brief further, define a stronger direction, and develop it with construction in mind — from first sketch to final detail on site.

statement.quote: A project is a single continuous decision. Architecture, interiors and construction are developed together — not handed from one discipline to the next.
statement.body: A brief is a starting point. We develop it into what the project should be — stronger than the initial idea, and resolved to the last detail. Design is not finished until it is built, so every decision is made with the reality of construction in mind.
statement.signal: Design intelligence — technical credibility — quiet execution.

studio.title: A practice built around the project.
studio.body: MDORRA is a design studio for architecture and interiors, with real execution experience behind it. Architecture, interiors and construction are developed as one continuous discipline — the design is not complete until it is built, and the construction is not complete until it is designed.

principles.title: Design
principles.body: Every commission begins with study — of site, use, material and light. The answer is found in the problem.

principles.title: Engineering
principles.body: Decisions are resolved on the drawing board and in the detail. Technical precision is part of the aesthetic.

principles.title: Execution
principles.body: The studio stays with the project until the final installation, so the built work matches the intended design.

contact.title: Tell us about your project.
contact.body: MDORRA takes on commissions across architecture and interiors — from villas and high-end apartments to offices and commercial spaces. Commissions are selective; projects where design matters come first.
contact.channelsEmpty: Commissions are accepted selectively and begin with a direct conversation. The studio's email, WhatsApp and social channels are listed here as they open.
contact.note: We respond to serious enquiries within a few working days.

faq.title: Practical answers.
faq.lead: Straight answers for commissioning a serious design project.

items.q: Does the studio accept every project?
items.a: No. MDORRA takes on a limited number of commissions at a time to keep full design involvement through delivery. Selectivity protects the depth of each project.

items.q: What types of projects do you take on?
items.a: Villas, high-end apartments, offices and commercial spaces where design matters. Commissions are accepted selectively — projects where the design can genuinely make a difference.
Yes. International commissions — including the Gulf — are assessed individually, coordinated remotely and supported on site as the project requires.

items.q: Do you work with clients remotely?
items.a: Yes. Design is developed digitally with a clear communication cadence, and site presence is scheduled where the project needs it.

items.q: What does the design process include?
items.a: A defined process: brief, direction, design, development and delivery — with the studio involved through execution.

items.q: Can you work from existing architectural drawings?
items.a: Yes. The studio works from existing drawings and documentation, integrating the new design with what is already established.
Design is the studio's front-facing work. Execution experience shapes every decision — and where the project calls for it, delivery is part of the service.
Yes. Visualization is part of the design process — used to test and communicate decisions before anything is built.

items.q: How do I start a project?
items.a: Write to the studio through the contact page with the project intent and scope. We respond directly, define the first phase precisely, and take on a limited number of commissions at a time.
